name: Nonprofit's Pack Defaults
description: Ships the pack's curated settings as self-healing defaults. Bundles a snapshot of options.txt and the whole config/ folder and, at preLaunch (before the game reads anything), restores any file that is MISSING. It never overwrites an existing file, so your live tweaks are untouched — but a fresh install, a wiped config, or a reset comes back up with the intended settings.
